response.description:
Azure Storage Mover now enables direct, secure data
migration from AWS S3 data in Virtual Private Cloud to Azure Blob Storage with
private networking. This update removes the need for manual pipelines or
third-party tools, supports automation through the Azure portal, and provides
real-time job monitoring. We had previously announced the General
availability of data transfer from AWS to Azure over public
networks.  Key benefits:  
 Automated, scalable workflows: orchestrate and
     monitor jobs with centralized dashboards.Secure, compliant transfers: integrated with Azure’s
     governance frameworks.  
 Accelerate modernization: unlock AI, analytics, and
     cloud innovation as soon as data lands in Azure.  Get started today and simplify
your multicloud data estate with Azure Storage Mover’s Cloud-to-Cloud
migration. Learn
more.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure Storage Mover enables private data transfers from AWS S3 to Azure Blob
